text:
maria: FYI hitting two separate issues in the python onboarding flow — want to capture here so docs/devex can triage.

maria: 1) README in python-samples links to `onboarding/async_quickstart.py` but the file 404s on main branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-samples/blob/main/onboarding/async_quickstart.py :eyes:

maria: 2) the async snippet in the quickstart that we do display (sync + async variants) runs into a runtime error for new users: `TypeError: 'Client' object is not an async context manager` when they try `async with Client(...):` — looks like the AsyncClient is not exposed or the example imports wrong symbol.

alex: Repro'd the 404, it's a path drift after we renamed the onboarding folder last month. PR to fix would be straightforward, tagging @docs for priority. :thumbsup:

sam: On the async CM issue, quick check: example shows `from redwood import Client` and then `async with Client() as c:` but our async entrypoint is `AsyncClient` and we don't alias it. So users get the sync Client which lacks `__aenter__/__aexit__` async dunder methods.

eli: Also saw a typing mismatch in stubs: typeshed/py.typed indicates `Client` is Union[SyncClient, AsyncClient] but runtime import returns SyncClient by default. MyPy fails with "Object of type \"SyncClient\" does not support async context manager" in the example.

maria: Another small but confusing bit: the auth retry example in the quickstart shows us wrapping calls with a `retry_on_401=True` flag. New users report that 401s from failing token refresh are not retried unless `enable_auto_refresh` is set in Dedicated builds. That's not obvious in the docs.

alex: Good catch. Docs should call out which flags are only honored in Dedicated/private deployments vs hosted. We should add a small note under auth section and change example to use `client = AsyncClient(..., enable_auto_refresh=True)` or explicitly show fallback logic.

sam: For immediate fix: I'll open two PRs — one to update the README link and one to replace the async import snippet with the correct symbol and a comment explaining AsyncClient vs Client. Assigning to @docs. Drafting commit message now.

eli: Can we also add a tiny CI link checker for the samples folder? Would have caught the 404 earlier.

maria: Yes please. A simple github action that curls markdown links in repo would have prevented this. @docs-bot can we add to infra backlog?

docs-bot: Created issue #4281 in docs backlog: "python-samples: fix onboarding async snippet and add link checker" — assigned to @alex. (automated)

alex: I'll attach a failing snippet example and the mypy output to the issue. Also including a minimal repro for the async context manager error:

```
# repro_async_cm.py
from redwood import Client

async def main():
    async with Client(api_key=\"x\") as c:
        await c.generate(\"hello\")

# results in: TypeError: 'Client' object is not an async context manager
```

maria: Nice repro. For the auth retry clarity I'll add a comment to the hosted quickstart saying: "Hosted API will not auto-refresh customer-managed tokens; use enable_auto_refresh for Dedicated/private or implement refresh in your app".

sam: Quick checklist for PRs:
- fix README link (path rename)
- update async example to `from redwood import AsyncClient` and show both sync/async usage
- adjust type stubs to make AsyncClient explicit so mypy doesn't infer SyncClient
- add short note on auth/retry behavior differences between Hosted/Dedicated
- add GH action link-checker for samples

eli: Sounds good. If anyone wants to take the typing change I can review — it's a small stub edit but impacts several examples.

maria: Thanks all. Filing this under "onboarding friction". if no objections I'll merge the README/link PR today and follow up on the AsyncClient PR tomorrow. :rocket:

alex: No objections. I'll ping @dev-tools as well to get the link-checker added to the org actions template.

maria: Closing loop: please add short note to release notes for next patch so customers know examples were updated.

sam: Will do.

maria: End of thread.
